row.name: Talent
row.description: You have a natural aptitude for a group of related skills, gaining a bonus to all of them. Each +1 bonus costs 5 points for a group of 6 skills, or 10 points for a broader group. Example: Slicer Talent (+1 to Slicing, Computer Operation, Cryptography, Electronics Operation (Comms), Electronics Repair (Computers), and Research) costs 10 points. Example: Outdoorsman Talent (+1 to Navigation, Naturalist, Survival, and Tracking for a specific environment) costs 5 points. Cost range: Varies (Starts at 5 points).
